summary.plain: A grid of 66 long transparent cells filled with gadolinium-doped liquid scintillator, surrounded by buffers and a muon veto, in a shallow underground room near the reactors.
summary.technical: Segmented detector of 66 acrylic cells (9 m long) filled with 11.34 t Gd-loaded liquid scintillator, 0.8 m oil buffers, a 1 m water buffer (105 t) and a 4-pi active muon veto; delayed positron / Gd-capture coincidence.
